articles.summary: We’re partnering with ev.energy, a global leader in smart EV charging services, to unlock the full potential of energy flexibility for EVs and other DERs – making smart energy management available to all homes and drivers, regardless of their specific hardware or make. Our partnership underscores a shared vision: to build an open and scalable flexible energy landscape through a pragmatic and technology agnostic approach.
articles.title: ev.energy and Enode are building an interoperable ecosystem to unlock flexibility for every EV driver

articles.summary: Today, the EU Data Act becomes fully applicable across the EU. For device manufacturers, energy apps and aggregators, this marks a significant milestone. The past few years have been about preparing. From today, the focus shifts to doing: making device data open and portable, enabling user choice, and creating services that thrive in an open ecosystem. The companies that see this as more than compliance will be the ones that win.
articles.title: Beyond compliance: How manufacturers can win with the EU Data Act

articles.summary: On September 12, 2025, the EU Data Act will become fully applicable across the EU. In our first blog we explained what the regulation is and why it matters for energy devices. This time, we’re looking ahead. What will actually change once the law takes effect? How will manufacturers, energy apps and aggregators, and end users experience the shift toward open energy data?
articles.title: The EU Data Act in practice: What’s next for devices, apps, and users

articles.summary: Europe’s solar and storage market is entering a new phase. Growth is spreading across more countries, and consumers are demanding more than efficient hardware. Home Energy Management (HEM) apps are becoming decisive in consumer choice. Our latest whitepaper explores how manufacturers can succeed in this new landscape. It looks at the strategies they are considering and shares new survey insights from leading manufacturers, including why 90% see HEM apps as essential to future sales and why most believe their own apps still fall short today.
articles.title: How PV inverter and battery manufacturers can unlock growth across Europe
